title: Epikloop lane
description: A lane profile, plugins/epikloop/lanes/<name>.json. Its fragment, lanes/<name>.md, holds Plan, Story and Retro sections, which the state reader prints into the plan, a story-worker's brief and the retro's brief. See docs/lanes.md.

name.description: The lane's name: the same as its file's, and the value of lane in a project's marker.

description.description: The kind of product the lane is for, in a few lower-case words. discover, adopt and architect list it when the lane is chosen.

requires.description: Programs a machine needs on PATH to build in this lane, beyond Node and git. doctor runs each with --version.

ui_test.description: The lane's UI test tool, or null for a lane without screens.

tool.description: The tool's name, as doctor reports it.

package.description: The npm package a product installs it as. doctor reads node_modules/<package>/package.json for its version.

allow.description: Command prefixes the guard allows in this lane's projects, each followed only by plain arguments. Never a command that fetches.
